en: A black-and-white vintage postcard image depicting a panoramic view of a city nestled in a valley with dramatic mountains in the background. Prominently visible are historical towers, a church spire, and a fortified castle-like structure. The city appears densely built, with narrow streets and traditional European architecture. The top left corner of the postcard has the printed text 'TRENTO'.
